extract: Harriet Maxine Hageman is an American politician and attorney serving as the U.S. representative for Wyoming's at-large congressional district since 2023. She is the Republican nominee for the 2026 United States Senate election in Wyoming, seeking to succeed incumbent Cynthia Lummis.
